blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Pope Leo XIV received the wooden pectoral cross of one of the Philippines’ newest bishops, Sean Mejia of the Apostolic Vicariate of Tabuk, in Rome on Sept. 10. The apostolic vicariate shared the moment on Facebook on Sunday, Sept. 20, saying the bishop “stood before the Holy Father…and though the moment was brief, he carried with him into that room all of us.” “Our bishop did something that will move every heart in Kalinga and Apayao,” it said. “He took his wooden pectoral cross…and placed it into the hands of Pope Leo XIV.” READ: Urdaneta bishop meets Pope […]...
